notes: Both participial construct phrases take their whole supplied *those that were to ...* frame, no article or relative morpheme standing in them (rules 41, 46), headed on the lexical verb; the *on* before each *sabbath* answers to the construct relation and stays with שַׁבָּת (rule 19).
*according to* heads on *according* (rule 24), the corpus heading that phrase there in 117 units and on *to* in none.
